evidence.detail: The class directly extends R436 CustomInterfaceBuilder and is constructed by the live custom-interface registry.
The builder repeatedly uses exact resource path 'teleport/SPRITE' and creates the screen around existing teleport widgets in the 18516/18517/18518/18519/18520 range.
The screen contains exact labels 'Teleport', 'Teleport <img=149>', 'Title of Location' and exact tooltip 'Select this teleport'.
Its private helper populates selectable teleport rows into scrollable widgets, proving this is the client teleport-selection presentation rather than a generic location panel.
